new_results.statement: For A=D+UKU^T with D physical diagonal, U^TU=I, s3(K)>=a, and a literal cut whose two restricted Gram matrices are >=gamma I and whose maximum physical row leverage q<=gamma/2, Q has continuous density <=6sqrt(2e)/(gamma a), hence the same O(interval length) bound.
A physical Rademacher cut gives both restricted Grams >=(1-sqrt(rq))I/2 for an r-column orthonormal frame with maximum row leverage q.
For r<=4 and q<=1/16, the preceding results give a continuous density <=24sqrt(2e)/s3(K)<56/s3(K), uniformly through s4(K)->0.
For two disjoint rank-two physical frames with row leverage<=1/2, every coefficient three-plane induces determinant-weighted physical 3-bases with disjoint-pair probability >=1/40.
